name: VR-NeRF
definition: A holistic approach for capture, reconstruction, and rendering of high-fidelity walkable spaces in virtual reality, achieving higher resolution, frame rate, and visual fidelity than standard NeRF.
summary: VR-NeRF is a holistic pipeline for capturing, reconstructing, and rendering high-fidelity walkable spaces in virtual reality, distinguishing itself by targeting native headset rendering with strict latency and resolution constraints.
